comment: Every entry checked by hand: studio original chosen ahead of the many live, compilation and deluxe copies. Drafted by Claude from the recorded data and the spec rules; every entry checked by hand. Owner review pending.

entries.name: Hell Awaits
entries.comment: "Hell Awaits" by Slayer on "Hell Awaits". Not a judgement call, but a near miss: "Hell Awaits (40th Anniversary Edition)" is dated 1985-04-08, earlier than the original 1985-06-19. "Anniversary Edition" is not a marker, so it is not a candidate; if it were, MATCH-8 would pick it.

entries.name: Angel of Death
entries.comment: "Angel Of Death" by Slayer on "Reign In Blood (Expanded)". "Reign In Blood (Expanded)" (1986-10-07) beats the 2015-dated "Reign In Blood" on date. Both are the studio recording.
